applied_deny_all.convention_not_evaluator: Gate-side convention (doc 04 decision 4, ruling 16): the gate denies before any LocalExecutionPolicy is built. LocalExecutionPolicy accepts empty frozensets; if one were built, check() would deny with its own text (e.g. 'local unit restriction'), after any earlier failing check. registry_deny_all therefore differs in reason text and check order from the evaluator. engine/safe_executor.py is not edited and its semantics are not claimed reproduced.
applied_deny_all.qg01_rule: The QG-01 old/new differential for a deny-all case compares disposition only (denied, no effect, claim not consumed, budget unchanged). Reason-text and first-failing-check equality are never asserted for deny-all.

applied_deny_all.can_authorize_action_reason: An empty dimension permits nothing; a restriction cannot authorize.

overlay_not_applied.can_authorize_action_reason: The host's own caller policy is returned unchanged (decision.py returns the normalized caller, or the raw caller if malformed); the registry contributed nothing; authorization stays with the OCS grant path.
overlay_not_applied.disclosure: For optional operations any refusal, including revoked, expired or invalid-signature selections, leaves the caller policy, which may be wider than a previously applied narrowing. This is frozen S04 semantics: evidence must carry registry_code and applied=false and must never be reported as enforcement or as protection.

refused.cause_rule: Every refused result carries detail.registry_code. Distinct codes may share a Runtime reason_code or failure_class only because that cause field exists; a path that cannot carry it is BLOCKED, not mapped.
